note: The SACRED lean checkout structure for the presentations sales+checkout upsell (GAUNTLET-LOOP DESIGN-OPUS §10.3 / §6.3-6.4 / F6). The checkout page is deliberately LEAN: it is the transactional step that follows the sales page, so it must not re-sell. Sections are named by id, checked IN ORDER, and the prover MEASURES the declared HTML element ledger (form fields, price, guarantee, trust, CTA) ignoring any self-report. Stripe-optional: when Stripe is NOT configured the checkout degrades to an order-form lead capture (F6) — the order-form fields remain REQUIRED, live payment becomes 'not_configured'. Method attribution and design patterns: proven direct-response checkout conventions (offer summary, price anchored, guarantee, trust badges, single CTA) as specified by Trevor's design.
section_band_note: word_min is the SACRED per-section stripped-word floor (FIX-XC-04c pattern). The prover MEASURES stripped section copy and IGNORES any self-report; under-band = HARD MISS (AF-PRES-CHECKOUT-SECTION-BAND). Header/footer carry lighter floors (chrome/legal), body sections carry substance floors.

order_form_fields.note: Fields the order form MUST declare. Email + full-name are the contact/identity core; payment fields are required when a real payment path exists, but in the F6 degraded (lead-capture) mode the checkout still collects order intent — never a fake 'live payment' claim.

cta_note: A single dominant 'complete order / order now' CTA. Distracting secondary CTAs are a structural violation of the lean principle.
